verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own hosted MCP server exposes a documented Create-Dashboard tool that builds dashboards with text cards and reports, so programmatic dashboard creation exists. However, the Query API only returns calculated report results, and the published OpenAPI spec list has no dashboards or saved-insights API. Missing for 10: a documented REST endpoint for creating dashboards, update/delete/list management of dashboards, programmatic creation and management of saved insights/reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and manage dashboards and saved insights programmatically via the API

citations.quote: Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
